**There are 7 continents:**

- Africa
- Antarctica
- Asia
- Europe
- North America
- South America
- Australia (or Oceania)

This is the standard model taught in most of the world. Some countries (e.g. parts of Eastern Europe, Russia, and Latin America) teach 6 by combining Europe and Asia into Eurasia, or 5 by also merging North and South America. The 7-continent model remains the most common globally.
